title: AIbit
tagline: AIbit: AI-powered health & fitness platform combining Web3 & Fitbit. Personalized insights via DeepSeek-R1/Venice AI, secure data on Nillion, dynamic NFT rewards. Achieve your goals & own your health!
description:
AIbit is a next-generation health and fitness platform designed to empower users to achieve their wellness goals through the synergy of an AI Agent & Assistant and Web3 technology. By seamlessly integrating with Fitbit's comprehensive activity tracking, AIbit provides a holistic view of a user's health metrics, including steps, sleep patterns, workout history, and heart rate data.

At the heart of AIbit is an intelligent AI Agent & Assistant, powered by DeepSeek-R1 via Venice AI. This agent analyzes user data to provide personalized recommendations, dynamic goal setting, and progress tracking. Crucially, Venice AI stores no user data, ensuring privacy and eliminating surveillance risks. Built on crypto-native principles, it also decentralizes GPU access, guaranteeing permissionless AI functionality. The AI Agent & Assistant leverages Coinbase's AgentKit for a Conversational Decision Process (CDP), enabling context-aware interactions with a memory of past conversations and access to agentic tools.

AIbit embraces Web3 through secure wallet connections via Privy, allowing users to manage digital assets and rewards. Dynamic NFT rewards are issued on Arbitrum based on fitness achievements, with a gamified incentive system planned for the future.

Data privacy is paramount. AIbit integrates with Nillion for secure, private data storage utilizing zero-knowledge proofs for data verification. Sensitive health data is stored offchain and encrypted, ensuring user control and confidentiality.

The interactive dashboard provides real-time visualization of health metrics and progress, offering personalized insights and AI-driven analysis.

In the future, AIbit plans to add more agentic features, enhanced NFT management, dynamic NFT updates based on AI decisions and health levels, a dynamic linkable watch face, and a watch companion app, further solidifying its position as a comprehensive and innovative health and fitness solution.
how_its_made:
AIbit is built using a combination of technologies, pieced together to create a seamless and innovative user experience.

AI Foundation: The core AI functionality is powered by DeepSeek-R1, accessed through Venice AI. This allows us to leverage a powerful language model for personalized insights and recommendations without compromising user privacy. Venice AI's decentralized GPU access ensures permissionless AI functionality, aligning with Web3 principles. We utilize Coinbase's AgentKit for a Conversational Decision Process (CDP), enabling context-aware interactions and memory of past conversations within the AI Agent & Assistant.

Web3 Integration: We use Privy for secure wallet connections, allowing users to seamlessly manage their digital assets and interact with the Web3 components of the platform. NFT rewards are issued on Arbitrum, chosen for its scalability and low transaction costs.

Data Privacy: Nillion is integrated for secure, private data storage. User's sensitive health data is stored offchain and encrypted, with zero-knowledge proofs used for data verification, ensuring data integrity and user control.

Frontend and Backend: The interactive dashboard is built using Astro for a dynamic and performant user interface. The backend is built using Node.js with Express, handling API requests, data processing, and communication with the various services.

Fitbit Integration: We utilize the Fitbit API to access user's health data, including steps, sleep patterns, workout history, and heart rate data.
Partner Technologies and Benefits:

Venice AI: Provides access to powerful AI models like DeepSeek-R1 while maintaining user privacy and decentralizing GPU access.

Privy: Enables secure and easy wallet connections for users.

Nillion: Ensures secure and private data storage with zero-knowledge proofs.

Coinbase AgentKit: Facilitates a Conversational Decision Process (CDP) for the AI Agent & Assistant, enabling context-aware interactions.
